scripts.build: cd frontend && bun run build && cd .. && bun run copy:php
scripts.build:prod: BUILD_SINGLE=1 BUILD_ENV=prod bun run build && node scripts/inline-html.js
scripts.dev: bun run copy:php && bun run --parallel serve:php dev:frontend watch:php
scripts.dev:docker: bun run copy:php && perl deploy.pl .env && bun run --parallel serve:php dev:frontend
scripts.serve-prod: bun run build && bun run deploy && php -S localhost:8010 -t build
